objects.name: a camel-hair overcoat on a hook
a folded stack of evening papers

people.name: Booker Bledsoe
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines

secret.description: Booker Bledsoe goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 11:30 PM while the victim is downstairs.
Hedwig Hochstetter is alone with Maureen Donnelly in the Roof Garden from 9:30 PM, and kills Maureen Donnelly at 9:30 PM.

coverSecret.description: Hedwig Hochstetter hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Service Stairs at 8:30 PM.

people.name: Fannie Feldman
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Fannie Feldman hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 9:30 PM.

people.name: Sol Rosenbaum
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Sol Rosenbaum meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 6:00 PM to 6:30 PM and asks for money.
Margarethe Kreuzer is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.
Lurline Mosley drinks alone in the Bar from 9:30 PM to 10:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

method.name: a gunshot
method.bodyEvidence: One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.

Maureen Donnelly was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 9:00 PM and 9:30 PM. One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.
A nickel-plated revolver is missing from the Front Desk. The drawer it was kept in is open and the oiled cloth is still in it.
Margarethe Kreuzer's papers do not hold up. A steamship ticket stub in the name of a man who died at Belleau Wood.
Found in the Front Desk: A promissory note for $4,000 signed by Booker Bledsoe, endorsed to Maureen Donnelly, three months past due.
Lurline Mosley says Maureen Donnelly told Booker Bledsoe that Friday was the end of it, one way or the other.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A draft codicil in Maureen Donnelly's hand striking Hedwig Hochstetter out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Lyman Ainsworth says Maureen Donnelly told Hedwig Hochstetter the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
